about: Every Cloudflare Worker this repository holds: where it lives, what it does, whether it is in service and how it gets there. The PM app's Platform screen is drawn from this file. `state` was checked from outside on the day in `checked`, by asking each Worker's address.

workers.name: pm-console-edge
workers.title: PM console
workers.does: Serves the PM app, does the core itself (the board, prompts, pull requests, ranked issues, the plan), sends messages to agents itself through the message bridge on a service binding (as service:pm-stack), reads the bridge's unified message pipeline, agents directory and credential state there too, and holds what waits for a machine.
workers.next: The platform the others join.

workers.name: message-bridge
workers.title: Message bridge
workers.does: The custom connector Claude and ChatGPT use to send and receive messages, and the page that sends one and shows the history.
workers.next: Deployed from Actions, stood up, checked and rolled back the way the PM console is; listed here with its last deploy.

workers.name: decision-events
workers.title: Decision events
workers.does: The Cloudflare half of the decision-set event pipeline: takes each event once and keeps it for the dashboard's questions.
workers.next: Deployed from Actions with VERSION set to the full commit SHA and /health required to report that exact SHA. The broader PM migration will add the console's staged route-flip and rollback flow.

workers.name: pm-service
workers.title: PM service
workers.does: The hosted PM service: serves the #9060 §6 read API (projects, item, roadmap, releases) from the tenant plane's Turso DB through the async store layer (CF-5c).
workers.next: Deployed from Actions by the versions standard (upload stamped with the commit SHA, preview health gate, promote). Serves real data once the PM_TENANT_DB_URL / PM_TENANT_DB_TOKEN Worker secrets are provisioned from the tenant plane.

workers.name: pm-notify
workers.title: pm-notify relay
workers.does: The edge half of the pm-stack dead-man's switch: sends one Web Push when the laptop aggregator goes silent, and one when it recovers.
workers.next: Local only until its deploy step (wrangler deploy) is run; step 1 of the notifications design. Listed here so the Platform screen shows it once it is deployed.

workers.name: mcpx
workers.title: mcpx front door
workers.does: The OAuth-fronted MCP door at mcpx.security.cab that proxies to the mcpx bridge on the laptop.
workers.next: Publishes a version from Actions; promotion to live is its own workflow.

workers.name: queue-transport-alert
workers.title: Queue transport alert
workers.does: Probes the queue's broker every ten minutes and alerts when it cannot be reached, so a total queue outage is seen.
workers.next: Deployed from Actions, stood up, checked and rolled back the way the PM console is; listed here with its last deploy. Its alert becomes one of the PM app's notifications.

workers.name: github-ci
workers.title: GitHub webhook receiver
workers.does: Receives GitHub's webhooks for every fleet repository and writes them to the store; nothing else receives them.
workers.next: Deployed from Actions, stood up, checked and rolled back the way the PM console is; listed here with its last deploy.

workers.name: voice-line
workers.title: Voice line
workers.does: Talk to the fleet and hear the answer: push-to-talk over a WebSocket held in a Durable Object.
workers.next: Deployed from Actions, stood up, checked and rolled back the way the PM console is; listed here with its last deploy. A spoken prompt goes in as any other prompt from the app does.

workers.name: muse-agent-handoff
workers.title: Muse hand-off
workers.does: Passes a new Muse lane its two access tokens once, as ciphertext that expires in fifteen minutes and can be claimed once.
workers.next: Deployed from Actions, stood up, checked and rolled back the way the PM console is; listed here with its last deploy.

workers.name: desktop-commander
workers.title: Desktop commander relay
workers.does: The fleet's own relay for remote desktop commands, in place of the vendor's metered one.
workers.next: Deployed from Actions, stood up, checked and rolled back the way the PM console is; listed here with its last deploy.

workers.name: fleet-hosted
workers.title: Fleet front door
workers.does: The hosted fleet's doors (stamping, query, queue, ingestion, sync) behind one sign-in and tenancy layer.
workers.next: Deployed by #14870 (2026-11-25) via Cloudflare versions with the queue door on the fleet-queue D1 database. The other doors' production wiring (RP issuer, tenancy DB, GitHub App material) is still owned elsewhere; until it lands they fail closed. Its queue door is how the edge will file, cancel and unblock tasks with no machine.

workers.name: atlas-search
workers.title: Atlas search
workers.does: The search surface across the Atlas databases, with each query kept in a Durable Object.
workers.next: Deployed from Actions, stood up, checked and rolled back the way the PM console is; listed here with its last deploy.

workers.name: cold-store-rehydrator
workers.title: Cold store rehydrator
workers.does: The read path of the Drive cold store: given an object's hash, pulls it out of its bundle, checks it and returns it.
workers.next: Deployed from Actions, stood up, checked and rolled back the way the PM console is; listed here with its last deploy.

workers.name: developing-today-backup
workers.title: GitHub backup webhook
workers.does: The webhook half of the GitHub mirrors: tells the mirrors what changed so they stay fresh.
workers.next: Deployed from Actions, stood up, checked and rolled back the way the PM console is; listed here with its last deploy.

workers.name: fleet-git-rehost
workers.title: Git rehost
workers.does: Serves read-only git clones of the four fleet repos from the backup copy in R2, so the code can still be cloned when GitHub and the backup laptop are both down.
workers.next: Deployed by hand with its deploy.sh; the backup laptop's publisher refreshes what it serves (#8584).

workers.name: pkarr
workers.title: pkarr door
workers.does: Publishes and resolves signed pkarr records over HTTP and DNS-over-HTTPS for the id system.
workers.next: Already deployed from Actions, in two confirmed steps (upload, then promote), so a run that succeeded is not always a deploy. Listed here with its last run.

workers.name: id-hosted-worker
workers.title: id hosted data plane
workers.does: The first local slice of id's hosted data plane.
workers.next: Local only until its own issue deploys it.

workers.name: id-worker-poc
workers.title: id world in a Worker (proof)
workers.does: A proof that an id world runs unmodified in a Worker with the same journal as the native host.
workers.next: A proof of concept: not for service.

workers.name: id-d1-journal-poc
workers.title: id journal on D1 (proof)
workers.does: A proof of the id journal kept in D1.
workers.next: A proof of concept: not for service.

workers.name: lab-ops-hub
workers.title: Lab ops hub
workers.does: One Worker that exercises the whole paid Workers surface at personal scale, inside the plan's included amounts.
workers.next: Deployed from Actions, stood up, checked and rolled back the way the PM console is; listed here with its last deploy. Its container images are already built by Actions.

workers.name: cf-container-hello
workers.title: Container hello (test)
workers.does: A clean-room test Worker that runs Cloudflare's hello-world container, built to debug the lab hub's container starts.
workers.next: A debugging aid: taken down once the lab hub's containers start reliably, or listed with the rest.
